postSave.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Your unsaved changes are still on this page.
postSave.serverReadFailed: {message}. Couldn't read the server version either; try saving again later. Your local edits are kept.

postSave.recoveryServerFailed: Couldn't read the latest server version, so nothing was restored. The local copy is kept; try again once you're back online.
postSave.recoveryApplied: The recovery copy is loaded into the editor but not saved to the server yet. Review it, then save manually.
postSave.discardRecoveryConfirm: Remove this local recovery copy? The server content won't change, and the copy can't be recovered once removed.
postSave.historyLoaded: The past revision is loaded but not saved to the server yet. Review and merge it, then save manually.
postSave.restoreRevisionConfirm: Restoring creates a new server draft and unpublishes the post if it's currently public. Unsaved edits are kept as a local copy first. Restore this revision?
postSave.revisionRestored: Revision restored as a new server draft. Engagement counts are kept.
postSave.revisionRestoreFailed: Couldn't restore the revision. Your current edits are kept.
postSave.leaveConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?

postWorkspace.preserved: Your earlier input was kept as a local copy.
postWorkspace.recoverPreserved: Restore earlier input and keep editing

postBatch.title: Confirm bulk action
postBatch.queue: {total} posts selected, processed in {count} batches of up to {limit}. This is batch {index}. Each batch must be previewed and confirmed separately; later batches never run automatically.
postBatch.closeHint: Closing skips the remaining batches. Submitted batches can still be checked under “Recent bulk actions”.
postBatch.summary: Action: {action}. {selected} posts explicitly selected, {allowed} can be processed.

effect.delete: Permanently deletes the posts with their comments, revisions, past URLs and engagement records; they can't be restored from the trash. Media files are kept. The list below shows how many referencing records will be deleted.
effect.trash: The posts are removed from public view. Body, comments, revisions and URLs are kept, and restored posts become drafts.
effect.archive: The posts are removed from public view and archived. Content and comments are kept.
effect.draft: The posts become unpublished drafts. Existing comments, revisions and URLs are kept.

postBatch.ticketHint: The preview is valid for 5 minutes. Versions and impact are checked again on execution, and changed items are skipped. Executed actions can be reopened under “Recent bulk actions” below the post list.
postBatch.expired: This ticket has expired and can't be executed. Check the result first, review the remaining posts, then close this panel and select and preview again.
postBatch.unfinished: The current batch isn't confirmed as finished. Check its result or continue with the same ticket before starting another bulk action.
postBatch.previewFailed: Couldn't preview this batch, so nothing was run. You can retry it; finished batches won't be submitted again.
postBatch.selectionLimit: You can select up to {limit} posts at once. Narrow the selection and try again.
postBatch.refreshFailed: The bulk result arrived, but the post list couldn't be refreshed. Refresh the list to verify.
postBatch.recordFailed: Couldn't load this action record. Close and try again.
postBatch.executeFailed: The full result didn't arrive. Check the result or continue with the same ticket; processed items won't be changed twice.
postBatch.queryFailed: Couldn't check the result. The ticket is kept, so you can retry.
